voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading the last 1000 candles, giving us the full price history to work with.
Next we apply a 10‑period Wilder’s Moving Average to smooth the data.
Then we calculate Bollinger Bands using a 20‑period basis for the bands.
We plot the middle band in a bright blue so it’s easy to spot.
Next we draw the upper band in a soft teal for contrast.
Finally we fill the space between the bands with a light teal at 27% opacity.

outro.voiceover: Now the chart shows Bollinger Bands plotted and filled, ready to backtest.
